verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts docs say alerts take action when issues match pre-defined rules, and the actions include notifications, tickets, webhooks and other integrations, for example posting to Slack when a new issue is created. Seer Autofix adds automatic scanning and triage of incoming issues, which extends event-driven automation. missing for 10: detail on rule condition and filter depth, any AI-native or programmatic way to author rules (e.g. via API or MCP), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how alert rules behave.
